newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Four Corners coal-fired unit back to 740 MW.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Four Corners coal-fired unit back to 740 MW.

text.p: The 750-megawatt (MW) unit 4 at Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona was restarted over the weekend and back up to 740 MW production by early Monday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said.
The unit was shut a week ago due to a boiler tube leak.
Four Corners also has a second 750 MW unit, two 175 MW units and one at 200 MW, all of which were said to be operating normally.

Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, has a 15 percent stake in Four Corners' units 4 and 5, while Edison International's, Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake.
